image.subject: Aunt Letty, a stout middle-aged Edwardian woman, hair pinned up, high-necked grey dress with a lace collar, stern face, hands on her hips in a Victorian drawing room, looking unimpressed at a tall woman with black hair

storyboard.claim: Letty decides Jadis is simply drunk, and the mystical terror collapses into a laugh.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Letty stands unbothered, hands on hips, while the tall black-haired woman glares back.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Jadis threatened Letty with her world's power; Letty answers with a flat domestic judgement.
storyboard.addedInformation: Letty's deflating reaction, shown on her face and posture.

storyboard.claim: Charn's magic does not work on Earth.
storyboard.concreteVisual: A plain statement card on a dark ground, no picture needed for the rule itself.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Letty's laugh set up the failure of Jadis's power.
storyboard.addedInformation: The rule that magic does not cross worlds.

image.subject: Jadis, a tall, beautiful woman with black hair and a cold white face, a long dark gown with a silver crown, standing in a plain grey London sitting room, her raised hands open and empty, no fire around them

storyboard.claim: Jadis has lost her magic on Earth.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Her raised hands are empty, no flame or light, the silver crown catching only ordinary gaslight.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: The narration says the physics of Charn no longer apply.
storyboard.addedInformation: Her open empty hands show the lost power.

image.subject: Jadis, a tall, beautiful woman with black hair and a cold white face, a long dark gown with a silver crown, standing calm and composed in a London hallway, eyes steady, looking ahead, not frightened

storyboard.claim: Jadis does not panic when her magic fails.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Her face is composed and still, her posture upright, no fear in her eyes.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Her power is gone and the narration says she does not react with fear.
storyboard.addedInformation: Her composure reads as calculation rather than panic.

image.subject: a tall woman in a long dark gown strides out through the open front door of a grey Edwardian London house onto a wet street, a stout woman in a grey dress with a lace collar is flung back against a hallway table

storyboard.claim: Jadis throws Letty aside and storms out of the house into the London streets.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Letty is flung back against a hallway table; Jadis strides through the open front door onto the wet street.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Jadis has just been dismissed by Letty and loses her magic.
storyboard.addedInformation: She is heading for transport, the cab on the street.

image.subject: a wet cobblestone London street at dusk, gaslamps glowing, horse-drawn cabs and carriages, Edwardian pedestrians in long coats and hats

storyboard.claim: The sensory chaos of the London street.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Cobblestones, gaslamps, horse cabs and carriages in a wet 1900 street.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Jadis has stepped out into this street.
storyboard.addedInformation: The scene's setting and period.

image.subject: a tall woman with long black hair and a dark gown with a silver crown, standing in a stone hall, calm and regal

storyboard.claim: Jadis rides on top of a stolen cab.
storyboard.concreteVisual: She stands astride the cab roof, hair streaming, the horse pulling through the street.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: She walked out into the street and now commandeers a cab.
storyboard.addedInformation: The image of a queen riding a cab through London.

image.subject: a tall woman with black hair flying out behind her like a comet's tail, gripping the reins of a strong chestnut cab horse, driving it hard down a London street

storyboard.claim: Jadis drives the horse Strawberry with fierce energy.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Her hair streams like a comet's tail while she drives the chestnut horse.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: She is standing on the cab, now she drives the horse.
storyboard.addedInformation: The horse's name is given on screen.

image.subject: a cab crashed against an iron lamp-post on a London street, a tall woman in a long dark gown pulling a heavy iron bar from the lamp-post, gaslight on the wet cobbles

storyboard.claim: Jadis wrecks the cab and pulls an iron bar from the lamp-post as a weapon.
storyboard.concreteVisual: The cab is crashed into the lamp-post, the woman holds up a torn iron bar.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: She is driving the cab and now she has crashed it.
storyboard.addedInformation: The iron bar is a physical weapon she improvises from London itself.

image.subject: a wooden study desk with open books and a single lamp, a long shadow on the wall

storyboard.claim: Uncle Andrew, the supposed mastermind, hides from Jadis.
storyboard.concreteVisual: He is folded under a table, eyes wide, not the master of anything.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Jadis is the powerful figure in the chaos, now she arrives at his door.
storyboard.addedInformation: The contrast between a self-styled magician and the real power.

image.subject: Uncle Andrew, an old man, wild grey hair, a sharply pointed nose, pale vain face, in a black frock suit with a white collar, fussing with his cravat in a tall mirror in a Victorian study

storyboard.claim: Andrew dresses in his finest suit to impress Jadis.
storyboard.concreteVisual: He straightens his cravat in front of a mirror, vain and nervous.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: He is terrified of Jadis and now prepares to win her over.
storyboard.addedInformation: His vanity shows in his grooming.

storyboard.claim: Andrew rewrites his memory of Jadis as a demure woman.
storyboard.concreteVisual: A quotation card printing Andrew's own words, 'a demure woman', as the way he now describes her.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: He was cowering and infatuated; now he protects his ego.
storyboard.addedInformation: His false description of her, in his own words.

storyboard.claim: Jadis is out of her depth yet acts with brutal certainty.
storyboard.concreteVisual: A statement card; the contrast is in the words.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: The narration moves from Andrew to Jadis.
storyboard.addedInformation: Her certainty despite not understanding this world.

storyboard.claim: The narrator draws a different conclusion about Jadis's power.
storyboard.concreteVisual: A statement card, commentary rather than action.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: The previous beat described her brutal certainty; this reframes it.
storyboard.addedInformation: The narrator's reading of the street scene.

image.subject: a group of Victorian London policemen in tall helmets and dark tunics facing a tall woman in a long dark gown with a silver crown, on a wet cobblestone street, no weapons drawn

storyboard.claim: She is fighting local police and errand boys in a street.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Bobbies in helmets stand facing a tall woman in a crown, no violence shown.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: She has just torn the iron bar from the lamp-post.
storyboard.addedInformation: The small, local, ordinary authority she is facing.

image.subject: a tall woman in a silver crown and long dark gown in the middle of a jeering London street, surrounded by errand boys tossing vegetables at her, Edwardian gaslamps and cabs behind

storyboard.claim: The queen's majesty is reduced to a Victorian street brawl.
storyboard.concreteVisual: The regal crown in an ordinary jeering street, vegetables thrown.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: The police and errand boys are the people she fights.
storyboard.addedInformation: The absurdity of the scene, the grandeur undercut by the setting.

storyboard.claim: She treats the London police as rival warlords.
storyboard.concreteVisual: A statement card carrying the idea of ego rather than a picture.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: The absurd street scene is now interpreted as her ego.
storyboard.addedInformation: Her self-image, which refuses the absurdity.

image.subject: Digory, a slim English boy of about eleven, short untidy brown hair, grey wool jacket and short trousers, scuffed boots, standing alone on a wet London street corner, looking at a crashed cab and a bent lamp-post, guilty

storyboard.claim: Digory sees the damage and knows he is responsible.
storyboard.concreteVisual: He stands small on the street, looking at the wreckage, shoulders tight.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Jadis's chaos is the result of what Digory did.
storyboard.addedInformation: His guilt is the emotional center of the scene.

image.subject: Digory, a slim English boy of about eleven, short untidy brown hair, grey wool jacket and short trousers, looking across a wet London street at a tall woman in a long dark gown, a yellow ring on his finger

storyboard.claim: Digory must get Jadis out of London.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Digory looks across the street at Jadis, the yellow ring on his hand.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: He feels responsible and now has a plan.
storyboard.addedInformation: The yellow ring is the means of his escape plan.

image.subject: Digory, a slim English boy of about eleven, short untidy brown hair, grey wool jacket, reaching out and grabbing the ankle of a tall woman in a long dark gown on a cobblestone street, a yellow ring held up in his other hand, a tangle of people sprawled around them

storyboard.claim: Digory grabs Jadis's ankle while holding the yellow ring.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Digory lunges, a yellow ring in his fist, grabbing the woman's ankle in a tangled heap.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: He decided to get her out, now he acts.
storyboard.addedInformation: The ring is the mechanism that will take her out.

image.subject: a chain of figures on a wet London street all holding each other: a girl of about eleven with dark plaited hair in a pinafore dress, a tall woman with black hair, an old man in a dressing gown, a cabman in a flat cap and heavy wool coat, and a strong chestnut horse, all touching

storyboard.claim: Digory's grip pulls a whole chain of people with him.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Polly, Jadis, Andrew, the cabman Frank and the horse Strawberry all linked by touch.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Digory grabbed Jadis, and the others touch her and each other.
storyboard.addedInformation: Everyone in the chain is named, so the viewer can follow who goes with them.

image.subject: a warm, lush wood of still pools, figures tumbling down into dark water with a splash under the trees, a faint glow between the trunks

storyboard.claim: The group is pulled through the wood between the worlds into an unmapped pool.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Still pools in a lush wood; the group falls into one with a splash.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: They were pulled out of London in a chain.
storyboard.addedInformation: The wood between worlds, the transit space.

storyboard.claim: The next beat is the lamp-post in the void.
storyboard.concreteVisual: A plain transition card.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: The pool dropped them somewhere unknown.
storyboard.addedInformation: Signals the transition to the next scene.

image.subject: Jadis, a tall, beautiful woman with black hair and a long dark gown, Digory, a slim English boy of about eleven in a grey wool jacket, and Polly, a girl of about eleven with dark plaited hair in a pinafore dress, huddled together in complete darkness, faintly lit at their edges, standing on nothing, arms raised for balance

storyboard.claim: They land in pitch black nothingness.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Three figures in an empty black void, nothing under their feet.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: They fell out of the pool.
storyboard.addedInformation: The void is abstract and empty.

storyboard.claim: The void has no wind, light or ground.
storyboard.concreteVisual: A statement card; the absence is the point.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: The darkness is described in more detail.
storyboard.addedInformation: No wind, no light, no ground.

image.subject: a tall woman in a long dark gown gripping a rough iron bar in the darkness, lit only by a thin edge of light on the metal

storyboard.claim: Jadis still holds the iron bar from the lamp-post.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Her hand tight on the iron bar in darkness.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: The void and the iron bar she tore from the lamp-post.
storyboard.addedInformation: The bar she carried from London now lies in the void.

image.subject: a close-up of a rough, dark iron bar, cold and dented, its paint flaking, resting in a dark void

storyboard.claim: The iron bar symbolises the industrial revolution.
storyboard.concreteVisual: A single cold iron object in darkness.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: The narration introduces the bar as a symbol.
storyboard.addedInformation: The bar stands for mechanical industrial force.

storyboard.claim: Dead metal brought into a place of pure magic.
storyboard.concreteVisual: A statement card carrying the idea.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: The iron bar symbol continues.
storyboard.addedInformation: The contrast of dead metal and living magic.

image.subject: a boy and a girl of about eleven looking up in wonder at a dark sky, the faint stars beginning to glow over them, a cold silence in the air

storyboard.claim: A cold, tingling music begins in the darkness; the stars sing.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Digory and Polly look upward as the stars begin to shine.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: The darkness was silent, now a sound begins.
storyboard.addedInformation: The stars are the source of the singing.

image.subject: a dense night sky full of bright constellations spread wide over a dark land

storyboard.claim: The sky fills with constellations and a deep voice joins the music.
storyboard.concreteVisual: A crowded sky of constellations.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: The stars were singing; now the sky is full.
storyboard.addedInformation: The sky becomes populated, the world starts to form.

image.subject: a huge golden-tawny lion with a shining mane, calm and majestic, standing in light, mouth open, singing

storyboard.claim: The deep voice is Aslan, and as he sings the world begins to exist.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Aslan stands in light, singing.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: The sky of constellations was waiting for a voice.
storyboard.addedInformation: The singer is Aslan.

image.subject: a streak of golden fire arcing across a dark sky above a bare plain, bright and clean, burning no one

storyboard.claim: Creation by fire: a flash of fire shoots across the sky.
storyboard.concreteVisual: A golden flash of fire crosses the night sky above bare land.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Aslan sang; now the world is created.
storyboard.addedInformation: The fire is the creation act, harmless.

image.subject: a huge golden-tawny lion with a shining mane, calm and majestic, pacing back and forth across bare dirt at dawn, the sun rising behind him

storyboard.claim: The sun rises and they see the singer, a massive golden lion, pacing in the empty dirt.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Aslan paces the bare earth as the sun comes up.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: The fire flashed; now the sun rises and reveals Aslan.
storyboard.addedInformation: The lion is seen for the first time.

image.subject: a huge golden-tawny lion with a shining mane singing with his head raised, above a green valley swelling into being, young trees rising out of the soil

storyboard.claim: A green valley swells into existence and trees grow out of the soil.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Aslan sings and a green valley with young trees appears.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Aslan paced the bare dirt; now he sings the land into being.
storyboard.addedInformation: The valley and trees are created by singing.

image.subject: green grass spreading across rolling hills under a bright sky, a warm sunrise over a new valley, a wide empty landscape

storyboard.claim: The grass spreads like a green fire across the hills.
storyboard.concreteVisual: A wide view of green hills being covered with grass.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: The valley and trees appeared; now the grass spreads.
storyboard.addedInformation: The land is alive and spreading.

left.label: ANDREW AND JADIS
left.subject: an old man in a dressing gown bent over a cluttered table of rings and instruments, a tall woman with a silver crown beside him in a dim red-lit room

right.label: ASLAN'S MAGIC
right.subject: a huge golden-tawny lion singing with his head raised above a green valley, trees rising from the earth

storyboard.claim: Aslan's magic is the opposite of Andrew's and Jadis's mechanical magic.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Two pictures side by side: exploitative magic at a table, organic magic in a valley.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: The narration recontextualises magic after the valley appeared.
storyboard.addedInformation: The comparison of two kinds of power.

storyboard.claim: Andrew and Jadis manipulate, destroy and use others as tools.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Three short items, text carries the list.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: The comparison of the two kinds of magic continues.
storyboard.addedInformation: The three ways the mechanical magic works.

image.subject: a huge golden-tawny lion with a shining mane standing in a green valley with his paws raised, grass and young trees rising around him from the earth

storyboard.claim: Aslan does not construct Narnia; he calls it forth and the earth responds.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Aslan calls, the grass and trees rise around him.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: The list contrasted mechanical and organic magic; now Aslan's way is shown.
storyboard.addedInformation: The earth responds to Aslan's call, not a construction.
